name: Christmas★Present
original_name: クリスマス★プレゼント
source:
On the night of December 16th, with Christmas close by…

In the corner of a town wrapped in the holiday spirit, our protagonist, Sajima Yuuji, was once again completely absorbed in picking fights with delinquents. 
All of a sudden, a girl clad in Santa Claus’s garments fell from the sky, crashing into him. Carrying the collapsed girl who to his room, he raped her without waiting for her to regain consciousness.

And so, the very next morning, this one Santa’s apprentice came to her senses. Upon realizing the situation she was in, she was bewildered. “No…it can’t be!”
Not only did he deprive her of her precious symbol of maidenhood, but also the source of her powers: her precious Saint’s Crest.
And so, promising to return the crest, he set the following terms: “Until the day of Christmas, you’ll be my slave.”

Abusing these powers, and laying his hands not only on this Santa’s apprentice, but also his stepsister Yuzu, stepmother Honami, and other women…what will become of this year’s Christmas?

[From [url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
translation:
12月16日晚上，圣诞节临近……

在充满节日气氛的小镇一角，主角佐岛雄二再次全神贯注地与不良少年打架。
突然，一个穿着圣诞老人服装的女孩从天而降，撞到了他身上。他把倒地的女孩抱到自己的房间，不等她清醒过来就强奸了她。

于是，第二天一早，这位圣诞老人的学徒就醒悟了。当她意识到自己的处境后，她感到很困惑。“不……不可能！”
他不仅剥夺了她珍贵的少女象征，还剥夺了她力量的源泉：她珍贵的圣纹章。
因此，在承诺归还徽章的同时，他提出了以下条件：“直到圣诞节那天，你将成为我的奴隶。”

滥用这些力量，不仅对这位圣诞老人的徒弟下手，还对他的继妹柚子、继母保奈美等女人下手……今年的圣诞节会变成什么样子呢？

[来自[url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
